name: Launch notices scheduled source adapter
description: Scheduling gate for the launch notices flow (typed contracts 1.0, no JSON). prepare_scheduled: a TimerTick in; node CONFIG (plugin.getConfig, SDS $PIV) launch_schedule_enabled must be true (else a FlowNotice Skipped 'disabled'), launch_schedule_producer_peer_id set and launch_schedule_source.access anonymous (a keyed tier needs a credential adapter and is refused); the tick is then forwarded to launch-schedule plan_launches. receipt_scheduled: the HttpResponse in; CONFIG must still be enabled with a producer; a 304 becomes a FlowNotice Unchanged (the stored notices are kept, nothing republished), anything else is forwarded verbatim to parse_launches. SDN auto-publishes configured source lanes after successful ingestion.

sequentialJustification.detail: Reads generic host configuration once per call; HTTP, signing, IPFS and persistence remain in existing host capability nodes. No threads.
